description: Defines an interface for building responses and events related to 'ModifyFeature' commands in the Eclipse Ditto framework, including methods for creating command responses and event triggers for feature modifications.

classes.name: ModifyFeatureLiveCommandAnswerBuilder
classes.description: Interface for building responses and events related to 'ModifyFeature' commands, providing nested interfaces for response and event factories.

classes.name: ModifyFeatureLiveCommandAnswerBuilder.ResponseFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating response objects for 'ModifyFeature' commands, including success responses and error responses for inaccessible or non-modifiable features.

classes.name: ModifyFeatureLiveCommandAnswerBuilder.EventFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating event objects triggered by 'ModifyFeature' commands, such as feature creation and modification events.

methods.name: created
methods.description: Builds a response indicating that the feature was created.

methods.name: modified
methods.description: Builds a response indicating that the feature was modified.

methods.name: featureNotAccessibleError
methods.description: Builds an error response indicating the feature was not accessible.

methods.name: featureNotModifiableError
methods.description: Builds an error response indicating the feature was not modifiable.

methods.name: created
methods.description: Creates a 'FeatureCreated' event for the 'ModifyFeature' command.

methods.name: modified
methods.description: Creates a 'FeatureModified' event for the 'ModifyFeature' command.
